PB-001.name: Strategy & Market Entry Playbook
PB-001.description: End-to-end methodology for market entry and growth strategy engagements
keyQuestions: What is the market size and growth trajectory?
Who are the key competitors and what is their positioning?
What are the unmet customer needs?
What is our sustainable competitive advantage?
What are the financial implications of each option?

PB-002.name: Operating Model & Performance Improvement Playbook
PB-002.description: Methodology for organizational design and operational excellence
keyQuestions: Where are the biggest performance gaps?
What processes are most critical to value creation?
What capabilities are missing or underdeveloped?
How should decision rights be allocated?
What quick wins can build momentum?

PB-003.name: Post-Merger Integration Playbook
PB-003.description: First 180-day integration methodology for acquired companies
keyQuestions: What are the critical processes to protect on Day 1?
What synergies are achievable in the first 180 days?
How do we integrate cultures without destroying value?
What are the key risks to integration success?
How do we measure integration progress?

PB-004.name: Applied AI Workflow Transformation Playbook
keyQuestions: What are the highest-impact AI use cases?
Is the data infrastructure ready for AI?
How do we measure AI ROI?
What change management is needed?
How do we scale from pilot to production?

PB-005.name: Corporate Finance Advisory Playbook
PB-005.description: Methodology for M&A advisory and capital allocation
keyQuestions: What is the quality of earnings?
What synergies are realistic?
What are the key risks to the deal?
How do we create value post-close?
When is the right time to exit?

checklist.item: Executive summary captures key findings in <1 page
Analysis is data-backed with clear methodology
Visuals are clear and support the narrative
All facts verified with at least two sources
Data sources cited and methodology explained
Recommendations prioritized by impact and feasibility
Next steps are specific with owners

IG-001.name: Executive Stakeholder Interview Guide
IG-001.description: Structured guide for C-suite and senior leader interviews

sections.name: Opening
questions: What is your role and how long have you been in it?
What are your top priorities this quarter?
How do you define success for this engagement?

sections.name: Current State
questions: Walk me through your current operating model
What are the biggest pain points in your team/processes?
Where do you see the most waste or inefficiency?
What's working well that we should preserve?

sections.name: Strategic Context
questions: How does your function align to the company's strategic goals?
What would transformative success look like for you?
What constraints (budget, people, time) should we be aware of?
Who are the key stakeholders we should engage?

sections.name: Closing
sections.purpose: Ensure nothing missed and set next steps
questions: Is there anything we haven't covered that you think is important?
What would make this engagement most valuable for you?
How would you like to be involved going forward?

IG-002.name: Operational Deep-Dive Interview Guide
IG-002.description: Guide for process-level interviews with front-line managers

sections.name: Process Understanding
questions: Walk me through your daily/weekly workflow
What systems/tools do you use?
Where do handoffs occur and what can go wrong?
What are the bottlenecks in your process?

sections.name: Performance & Metrics
questions: What metrics do you track?
How are you measured on performance?
What does 'good' look like vs. actual performance?
Where do you lack visibility?

sections.name: Pain Points
questions: What takes more time than it should?
Where do errors or rework occur?
What workarounds have you developed?
If you could change one thing, what would it be?

IG-003.name: Customer/Client Interview Guide
IG-003.description: Guide for external customer and market interviews

sections.name: Context Setting
questions: Tell us about your organization and role
What is your approach to [relevant category]?
Who are your current providers/partners?

sections.name: Needs Assessment
sections.purpose: Identify unmet needs and pain points
questions: What are your biggest challenges in this area?
What would an ideal solution look like?
What have you tried before and why didn't it work?
What would make you switch from your current approach?

sections.name: Decision Process
questions: How do you evaluate solutions in this space?
Who else is involved in the decision?
What factors matter most (price, quality, service)?
What would make this a 'must-have' vs. 'nice-to-have'?

IG-004.name: Post-Acquisition Integration Interview Guide
IG-004.description: Guide for integration readiness and cultural assessment

sections.name: Leadership Alignment
questions: What is your vision for the combined entity?
What are the biggest integration risks you see?
How do you want to be involved in the integration?
What cultural elements are most important to preserve?

sections.name: Operational Readiness
questions: What processes absolutely cannot be disrupted?
Where are the key customer touchpoints?
What systems integration is most critical?
What talent retention risks exist?

IG-005.name: AI Readiness Interview Guide
IG-005.description: Guide for assessing AI adoption readiness

sections.name: Current State
questions: What tools/systems are currently in use?
How is data currently collected and used?
What manual processes consume the most time?
Have you experimented with AI/ML before?

sections.name: Opportunity Assessment
questions: Where do you see the biggest opportunity for automation?
What decisions could benefit from better data/insights?
What would a 10x improvement look like in your workflow?
What concerns do you have about AI adoption?

IG-006.name: Board & Investor Interview Guide
IG-006.description: Guide for board member and investor conversations

sections.name: Strategic Vision
questions: What is your 3-5 year vision for the portfolio?
What return thresholds do you target?
How do you think about risk and diversification?
What exit strategies are you considering?

sections.name: Portfolio Performance
questions: Which portfolio companies are exceeding expectations?
Where do you see the biggest value creation opportunities?
What governance and reporting improvements would you like?
How do you approach capital allocation decisions?

WG-001.name: Strategy Workshop Facilitation Guide
WG-001.description: Guide for facilitating strategy development workshops
tips: Start with alignment on the problem
End with clear action items and owners

WG-002.name: Operating Model Design Workshop
WG-002.description: Workshop for designing future-state operating models

WG-003.name: Post-Acquisition Integration Workshop
WG-003.description: Workshop for planning first 180 days of integration

BP-001.title: The Pyramid Principle
BP-001.description: Start with the answer, then provide supporting arguments
details: Lead with the recommendation or conclusion
Group supporting ideas into 3-5 key arguments
Order arguments logically (time, importance, etc.)
Summarize at each level of the hierarchy

BP-002.title: MECE Principle
BP-002.description: Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive problem structuring
details: Break problems into non-overlapping categories
Ensure all possibilities are covered
Use issue trees to visualize MECE structures
Validate completeness at each level

BP-003.title: 80/20 Rule (Pareto Principle)
BP-003.description: Focus on the 20% of factors driving 80% of impact
details: Identify the vital few vs. trivial many
Concentrate resources on high-impact areas
Don't let perfect be the enemy of good
Regularly reassess priorities

BP-004.title: So What Test
BP-004.description: Every slide/finding should pass the 'so what?' test
details: Ask 'so what?' after every data point
Ensure findings lead to actionable insights
Connect analysis to client objectives
Remove or reframe findings that don't pass

BP-005.title: Hypothesis-Driven Approach
BP-005.description: Start with a hypothesis and test it with data
details: Formulate initial hypothesis early
Design analysis to test (not prove) hypothesis
Update hypothesis as new data emerges
Be willing to abandon hypothesis if data contradicts

BP-006.title: One Message Per Slide
BP-006.description: Each slide should convey a single clear message
details: Write the headline as a takeaway message
Support with one key visual or data point
Use speaker notes for supporting detail
Test by showing slide for 3 seconds - message clear?

BP-007.title: Data Triangulation
BP-007.description: Validate findings with multiple data sources
details: Use at least 2-3 sources for key facts
Triangulate quantitative and qualitative data
Note data limitations and assumptions
Be transparent about confidence levels

BP-008.title: Stakeholder Mapping
BP-008.description: Identify and engage key stakeholders early
details: Map influence vs. interest matrix
Identify executive sponsor and day-to-day contact
Tailor communication to each stakeholder type
Keep stakeholders informed of progress and risks

BP-009.title: Quick Wins First
BP-009.description: Build momentum with early, visible successes
details: Identify low-effort, high-impact improvements
Execute quick wins in first 30-60 days
Communicate successes broadly
Use momentum to tackle larger changes

BP-010.title: Storylining
details: Start with a hook to engage the audience
Build tension with the problem/opportunity
Deliver insight as the turning point
Resolve with clear recommendations

BP-011.title: RACI Matrix
BP-011.description: Clarify roles: Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed
details: Define RACI for each workstream/task
Ensure exactly one 'Accountable' per item
Communicate RACI to all stakeholders
Review and update as project evolves

BP-012.title: Lessons Learned Retrospective
BP-012.description: Capture and apply learnings from each engagement
details: Conduct retrospective at engagement close
Document what worked, what didn't, and why
Identify actionable improvements for next time
Share learnings across the KMT team
